evidence.r1: Glass is limited to top filters, search, zoom and bottom vehicle actions; alert and vehicle data panels are solid in both schemes.
evidence.r2: Bottom vehicle action buttons use plain fills inside one material strip in both menu captures.
evidence.r3: Top filters/search and lower zoom/actions each serve distinct operational controls in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Top and bottom control surfaces share a frosted material appearance in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear glass is visible; filters use frosted surfaces over the detailed map in both schemes.
evidence.r6: Bottom Call operator has a neutral emphasis fill and no competing coloured action backgrounds in either menu capture.
evidence.r7: Light zoom and filter surfaces pick up the harbour and map underneath rather than uniform solid fills.
evidence.r8: Top filters and zoom are capsules; solid sidebar and platter use fixed corners in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Bottom action strip has tight rectangular corners while its inset Call operator is strongly pill-shaped in both menu captures.
evidence.r10: Bottom Call operator, Hold and Follow buttons are capsule-shaped in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Top route, status and search occupy three separate groups in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Bottom vehicle text actions share their background with the icon-only close button in both schemes.
evidence.r13: Top route filter has one material behind the full selector rather than separate glass around each dot in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Top route and status groups have deliberate gaps and consistent surfaces in both schemes.
evidence.r15: No scroll-edge fade appears around top controls over the map in either scheme.
evidence.r16: Map street grids and water remain behind top filters and bottom zoom in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Map lines continue directly beneath floating filters and zoom in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Top search placeholder is grey on translucent material; numeric contrast for all labels is not established in either scheme.
evidence.r19: Light reduced controls remain readable, but increased contrast and reduced motion states are absent.
evidence.r20: Map extends to all window edges behind the floating controls in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Left alert sidebar forms a hard solid boundary over the map, not a visible background extension, in both schemes.
evidence.r22: Left alert sheet and right vehicle platter have explicit opaque backgrounds in both schemes.
evidence.r23: Right platter endpoints in light and dark do not establish emergence or press animation.
evidence.r24: Top route control contains eight saturated colour dots rather than monochrome content in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Top route numbers and action labels stay neutral and separated from coloured route lines in both schemes.
